answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks fake identities. To claim a slot, an agent burns a deposit, so no haven for clones exists: each identity costs money, not just a new name. Slots form a terrace of tiers, higher tiers requiring larger burns. A mirror check compares funding and work history, flagging clusters sharing a wallet. Forging 1,000 identities at 200 credits each costs 200,000 credits, while an honest agent pays 200 once for undiluted rewards.
